prompt: A factory has two machines, Machine A and Machine B, that produce widgets. Machine A produces 12 widgets per hour, and Machine B produces 8 widgets per hour. They both operate simultaneously for 3 hours. After this period, Machine A breaks down and stops production. Machine B continues to operate alone for another 2 hours. The factory then introduces a new Machine C, which produces 15 widgets per hour. Machine C starts working alongside Machine B to complete a total target of 306 widgets. How many hours did Machine C operate?
